aboutSection.heading: About Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas
aboutSection.p1: Established in 2022 in Garchuk, Guwahati, Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas is one of Assam's premier automotive gas retrofitment, cylinder testing, and advanced diagnostic facilities. Located strategically on National Highway 37 (NH-37) opposite Nezone Steel, near the Indian Oil Petrol Pump in Paschim Boragaon, our workshop provides state-of-the-art alternative fuel conversion solutions for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and fleet operators throughout the Northeast.
aboutSection.p2: With deep technical expertise in automotive combustion systems, electronic control units (ECU), and high-pressure fuel delivery, our certified technicians specialize in sequential CNG and LPG kit installations, dynamic fuel injection calibration, mandatory 330-bar hydrostatic cylinder testing, and preventive autogas maintenance. Every installation is engineered to deliver 60% to 70% reduction in running fuel costs while strictly conforming to national CMVR and AIS safety standards.
highlights: Authorized Dealer for World-Class Sequential Kits

missionSection.heading: Our Mission
missionSection.statement: To empower vehicle owners and commercial transport operators across Guwahati, Assam, and the Northeast with safe, reliable, and cost-efficient automotive alternative fuel systems. We are dedicated to delivering precision mechanical fitment, computerized fuel calibration, and complete technical transparency—making green, economical automotive mobility accessible and dependable for every driver.

pillars.title: Environmental Sustainability
pillars.desc: Actively reducing vehicular carbon footprints and harmful tailpipe emissions across Assam through clean-burning compressed natural gas.

pillars.title: Substantial Fuel Savings
pillars.desc: Delivering 60% to 70% reduction in per-kilometer running costs with optimized sequential systems delivering 22 to 26 km per kg.

pillars.title: Uncompromising Safety
pillars.desc: Ensuring every pipeline, valve, and high-pressure joint meets stringent AIS-024 / AIS-028 directives and PESO safety protocols.

visionSection.heading: Our Vision
visionSection.statement: To be recognized as Northeast India's most trusted center of excellence for automotive alternative fuel propulsion, statutory cylinder safety testing, and sustainable mobility engineering. We envision a future where every converted vehicle operates with peak efficiency, factory-grade throttle response, and absolute safety, backed by continuous diagnostic innovation and lifelong customer trust.

legal.privacySubtitle: Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas is committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring technical transparency across all automotive services.

privacySections.heading: 1. Information We Collect Through Enquiry Forms
privacySections.content: When you submit an appointment enquiry, technical consultation request, or contact form through our website, we collect your name, mobile phone number, vehicle model, address, and service requirements. We do not collect unnecessary private information, financial card credentials, or biometric data through this website.

privacySections.heading: 2. Purpose of Collecting Information
privacySections.content: The details you submit are utilized solely for technical and operational workshop purposes:
list: Evaluating vehicle engine suitability and sequential kit compatibility for your specific car model.
Scheduling workshop bay availability and allocating certified technical staff at our Garchuk workshop in Guwahati.
Preparing statutory documentation and compliance certificates required under CMVR and DTO guidelines.
Facilitating customer communication regarding appointment status, parts availability, and technical advisories.

privacySections.heading: 3. How Personal Information is Used
privacySections.content: Your contact details are used exclusively by our certified automotive advisors and workshop technicians to contact you via telephone or WhatsApp. We do not use your information for unsolicited commercial telemarketing or sell customer databases to third-party marketing brokers.

privacySections.heading: 4. No Customer Account or Password Storage
privacySections.content: In strict accordance with our engineering privacy principles, this website does not operate customer registration accounts, user profiles, or public customer logins. You do not need to create passwords or store sensitive account credentials with us online.

privacySections.heading: 5. Data Protection & Security Measures
privacySections.content: All data transmissions through our website forms are secured using industry-standard HTTPS encryption. Server endpoints apply rate limiting, parameter sanitization, and strict administrative access controls to prevent unauthorized access or interception.

privacySections.heading: 6. Data Retention & Third-Party Disclosure
privacySections.content: Customer enquiry records are retained only as long as necessary to complete your workshop service, issue statutory certification, and maintain warranty compliance records. We do not share your details with external third parties except authorized government transport authorities (DTO/RTO) when mandated by statutory vehicle endorsement regulations.

privacySections.heading: 7. User Rights & Contacting Our Data Officer
privacySections.content: You have the right to review, update, or request the deletion of your contact records from our active workshop scheduling database. For privacy questions, contact our desk at maakamakhyaautogas@gmail.com or call our Garchuk facility directly at +91 9678******.

legal.termsSubtitle: General commercial terms and engineering standards governing retrofitment, testing, and servicing contracts with Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas.

termsSections.heading: 1. Scope of Automotive Services & Regulatory Conformance
termsSections.content: Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas operates certified automotive alternative fuel retrofitting, diagnostic calibration, scheduled maintenance, and cylinder testing facilities in Guwahati, Assam under the statutory framework of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) and Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO). All recommendations are subject to physical vehicle inspection.

termsSections.heading: 2. Website Usage & Technical Information Accuracy
termsSections.content: The materials, guides, and technical specifications published on this website are provided for consumer guidance and educational reference. While we strive to maintain complete accuracy, automotive component availability and regulatory guidelines may vary depending on vehicle manufacturer specifications and transport department notifications.

termsSections.heading: 3. Appointment Enquiries vs Confirmed Bookings
termsSections.content: Submitting an appointment enquiry form on this website logs an official request for workshop service. An appointment is only confirmed once an authorized service advisor contacts you via telephone or WhatsApp, verifies vehicle suitability, and formally allocates a workshop bay slot.

termsSections.heading: 4. Vehicle Mechanical Condition & Pre-Inspection Requirements
termsSections.content: Vehicles presented for CNG sequential kit installation or diagnostic tuning must be in sound mechanical condition. Prior engine faults including ignition defects, valve leakage, blown head gaskets, or weak compression must be rectified before calibration. Our certified technicians reserve the right to advise against conversion if an engine fails baseline compression benchmarks.

termsSections.heading: 5. Pricing, Quotations & Hardware Authenticity
termsSections.content: Initial price estimates provided online or over the telephone are indicative and subject to final confirmation following physical engine inspection. All components, sequential kits, reducers, and cylinders installed by Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas are 100% genuine, backed by manufacturer warranties, verifiable serial numbers, and authorized distributor guarantees.

termsSections.heading: 6. Cylinder Hydrostatic Testing & Safety Condemnation Rules
termsSections.content: In strict compliance with PESO Gas Cylinder regulations, every cylinder subjected to hydrostatic pressure testing must meet statutory safety parameters. Any cylinder exhibiting permanent volumetric expansion exceeding permissible limits, severe internal corrosion, structural pitting, or heat damage will be officially condemned and cannot be recertified or reinstalled.

termsSections.heading: 7. Statutory DTO Endorsement Responsibilities
termsSections.content: Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas issues authentic compliance certificates and documentation for legal endorsement. Final endorsement on the vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) remains subject to physical inspection and statutory approval by the respective District Transport Office (DTO) in accordance with Assam state guidelines.

termsSections.heading: 8. Intellectual Property & Limitation of Liability
termsSections.content: All technical diagrams, articles, photographic documentation, and branding on this website are proprietary to Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas or licensed partners. Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas shall not be liable for damages resulting from improper third-party vehicle modifications or failure of vehicle owners to observe prescribed maintenance intervals.

termsSections.heading: 9. Governing Law, Dispute Resolution & Contact
termsSections.content: All commercial transactions, service contracts, and statutory compliance matters are governed by the laws of India and subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Guwahati, Assam. For inquiries or terms clarification, contact us at maakamakhyaautogas@gmail.com or visit our Garchuk facility.
